name: travelos
description: Let's Go Pipi local-first Android application

scripts.android:sync: npm run build:web && cap sync android
scripts.android:debug: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.android:release: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
scripts.test: node --test tests/guardrails.test.mjs tests/prompt-gate.test.mjs tests/request-router.test.mjs tests/v3-flow.test.mjs tests/mobile-data.test.mjs tests/voice-quality.test.mjs tests/voice-mode-flow.test.mjs tests/voice-translate.test.mjs tests/voice-translation-history.test.mjs tests/food-discovery.test.mjs tests/hotel-area-discovery.test.mjs tests/named-area-discovery.test.mjs
scripts.eval:expanded: npm run eval:offline && npm run eval:router && npm run eval:knowledge && npm run eval:live
scripts.eval:baseline: npm run eval:offline && npm run eval:live
